workflowNotes: No project or IndexedDB data exists on localhost:3007; app preference key stardew-planner:planner-ambience-options exists and was restored byte-for-byte after option testing.
Standard Farm starts with four source-defined starter buildings; no user-added canvas placements existed. Canvas edits, if tested, must restore to this four-building baseline, not empty placements.
Floating third-party-style “导出外链” control is visible outside the planner root and was not clicked.

First free-placement locator used lowercase “Free placement” and matched no control; DOM showed exact accessible label “Free Placement”. The script stopped before that action, then exact label was used and Cancel verified.

The previous checkpoint contained summarized catalog findings but no persisted raw page.evaluate return batch. catalogCoverage records the observed values verbatim from the browser run; it is not represented as a raw protocol dump.

Canvas audit was reset by reloading the isolated no-project Standard Farm after Undo/Redo; Farm Summary returned to 4 items, selection/pending UI was absent, Select was active, Zoom was off, Undo/Redo were disabled, and the local project key remained absent.

Supported-item Fill check: selected Tilled Dirt, verified Fill pressed plus the Filling Tilled Dirt pill, then dragged one 36px rectangle; Farm Summary remained at 4, Undo stayed disabled, and no alert appeared. Tile eligibility was not independently validated, so this single no-op is not classified as a product defect; no coordinate retry was made.

Fill/Torch source classification: object:93 Torch is mapped from Lighting and lacks fill in allowedTools; the UI still selected Fill and displayed a Filling Torch pill. Preserve as a confirmed unsupported-item UI mismatch, not a generic Fill failure.

Earlier automation mistakes were inspected: a Map wait used the wrong title and swallowed a timeout, while a separate Node-side document reference threw before any click. These are test-script issues, not application failures; no app state was changed by the latter.

Mobile continuation completed after the competitor comparison pause: p1 map tabs, responsive catalog Browse/Collapse, toolbar state, and cleanup were recorded in mobileCoverage; root later resumed the page for a separate follow-up.

The mobile chooser screenshot at scrollY=418 records a lower-page positioning context, not a direct-reload layout. The first action that produced scrollY=418 was not retained; body scroll-lock and touch-scroll-to-list-end were not measured.

Before handing p1 back, device metrics were cleared, Network.setCacheDisabled was set to false, the audit-created editor-preferences key was removed only after its value matched the restored default exactly, and the baseline ambience key was preserved.
